messages:
ashley: quick preflight check for the postmortem action list before we close INC-1234 — want to lock owners+dues for the cross-team pieces.
kevin: I can take the DB migration audit + schema compatibility tests. target EOD Tue?
ashley: thanks — can you confirm the PR and test run you’ll use? we need a reproducible test matrix for the rollout doc.
kevin: I’ll use PR #4921 (db/migrate-sanity) and run the `smoketest` matrix: `postgres:13 -> postgres:15` + `feature_flags=on/off`.
mira: I’ll own the canary plan and traffic ramp for Dedicated region eu-west. aiming for Fri 9am PT for first canary.
ashley: assigned — can you put the plan in the runbook page and add the rollback steps? link to template: https://go.redwood/runbooks/canary-template
mira: yep, will add steps + load thresholds. owner: mira, due: Thu EOD. pinging @kevin for the db cutoff window.
sanjay: I’ll update the infra playbook with the new autoscaler knobs. action: add `min_replicas` override and a metric alert for token queue growth. due: Wed midday.
ashley: ok owners recap: kevin -> DB migration audit (PR #4921) due Tue EOD; mira -> canary plan + runbook due Thu EOD; sanjay -> autoscaler + alerts due Wed 12:00.
kevin: small ask — I need a green on integ-tests (CI job `release/sanity`) before I sign off. can the infra team ensure the node pool is available for a one-hour window on Tue? @sanjay
sanjay: noted, will reserve a maintenance window Tue 14:00-15:00 PT and add it to infra-calendar.
ashley: also flagging a dependency: frontend needs the new expose endpoint (API-857) to gate traffic split. @mira do you have a contact?
mira: frontend contact is @julia-frontend, I’ll loop her into the runbook edit for the split strategy.
ops-bot: incident-note: postmortem draft is at https://go.redwood/incidents/INC-1234/postmortem-draft — please add action items to the "Followups" section.
ashley: thanks bot. one last thing: if any owner expects delays, shout early so we can reassign before the freeze.
kevin: ack — I’ll post progress in this thread after the CI run.
mira: ack, will add canary doc + @julia-frontend mention by tomorrow.
sanjay: ack, infra slot booked and alert PR will be up by EOD Wed.
